answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact: one trust thread then ties each wallet to real capital at risk, so spawning a nebula of fake accounts costs the attacker a bond per identity, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice. Repeat offenders earn an umber stain on their public reputation record, visible to every counterparty, so cheap re-entry after being slashed no longer pays.
